title: Existence of a hard Boolean function for DAG circuits
statement: For every natural number $n>1$, there is a Boolean function on $n$ input bits such that every well-formed acyclic Boolean circuit with at most two inputs to each gate and size at most $2^n/(10n)$ disagrees with the function on at least one input.
